name: Curl removal (first Reidemeister move)
summary: A wire with a curl (crossing itself through a braiding) is a straight wire.
description:
Backens, Perdrix and Wang show that the meta-rule *only connectivity matters* can be replaced by the axioms of a braided autonomous category, provided one adds the loop axiom (R1): a curl in a wire, made with the braiding (either way round), can be pulled straight. Together with the other rules this recovers the full ZX-calculus for stabilizer quantum mechanics.

In PyZX and ZXLive only the connectivity of a diagram is stored, so this axiom holds by construction. The paper distinguishes over- and under-crossings, which are not drawn here.
unchecked_reason: a wire crossing itself cannot be represented in PyZX graphs, where only connectivity matters
